coverage: 288 actual Mobile-rendered captures, three stages x day/night x 48 samples over 4.7 seconds; 31 fixed material patches. All declared whole-scene card cels observed. Not a full 48-second cloud drift loop or all interactive states.
method: Linear-light Rec.709 luminance and HSV saturation in fixed unmasked rectangles. Temporal min/max includes movement and mixed materials, so is not a direct palette-flicker measurement. Original images remain unchanged; corrections stay opt-in.

findings.action: Compare matching plant families and painted highlight/shadow bands; selectively compress foreground highlights and align hue only where contextual review supports it. Do not globally equalize saturation or remove atmospheric depth.
Review matching species at camera seams; existing source samples show larger arrival saturation, but different species/shade prevent a universal numeric target.
Remaining eight cloud cards have one cel plus drift; low cloud sea and broad lawn remain insufficiently animated. New pointed tuft covers only one foreground accent.
Separate windows/glints from opaque prop ambient grade; capture water ripple peak/fade, bridge contact, actors, animals and touch cues before claiming complete color coverage.

acceptance: No quality score assigned. Last owner score remains 3.5/5. Device performance, owner visual acceptance, all interactions and complete material isolation remain open.

observations: Castle right foreground cream/yellow flowers and broad leaves have stronger local highlights than adjacent hedge; prioritize leaf highlight width/value and local shadow matching while preserving flower accents.
Foreground broad smooth leaves and fine textured hedge still read as different paint treatments in places. Saturation correction alone is insufficient.

Night foliage loses internal detail; evaluate shadow compression without raising the entire night palette. Roshan and castle remain prominent; gameplay readability and emission require separate acceptance.
Paths, bridge and castle silhouette remain visibly distinguishable in these still captures. This does not establish full route, motion or device acceptance.
